title: 5a brainstorm: core model design
description:
Brainstorm the core model redesign using vidhi-brainstorm. Key areas:
- Ephemeral/durable storage partition schema design
- Layered adapter trait interface (core parse trait + extension traits)
- Symbol/edge schema evolution for multi-language support
- Module rename strategy (fca/ → conventions/, dd/ → constraints/)
- How existing code evolves into the new structure

Input: docs/sutra-architecture.md, docs/sutra-vision.md, current codebase
Output: shared understanding ready for PRD
decisions: Single DB with table-level ephemeral/durable partition. Durable tables reference ephemeral data by name (qualified_name, file_path), never by integer PK. Orphaned references handled by reconciliation report, not prevention — most durable records reference patterns/paths, not individual symbols, and expiration-on-rename is correct behavior for the rare symbol-level references.

Layered adapter trait interface: core LanguageAdapter trait (language_id, extensions, parse) + optional extension traits via as_fca_source() pattern. Each language is a struct implementing LanguageAdapter. FcaAttributeSource is the first extension trait; future traits added as capability PRDs need them.

Core owns tree-sitter infrastructure (parser pooling, timeouts, memory). Adapter specifies grammar via grammar() method, receives ParseContext with parsed tree and source bytes. Adapter focuses on extraction logic only.
ParseResult uses tree structure for symbols (children field) instead of flat list with parent_qualified_name. Makes containment relationships explicit in parse output.

SymbolKind stays as flat enum — add variants as languages are added. language_attrs JSON column on symbols for language-specific structured data. flags field stays for cross-language booleans (is_test, is_generated). signature stays as human-display text; language_attrs is the machine-readable form.

FCA attribute extraction splits: generic parts (complexity bucketing, naming, directory context) become shared helper. Language-specific parts move into FcaAttributeSource implementations per adapter. Reads from language_attrs, not signature string.
Module renames (fca/ → conventions/, dd/ → constraints/) deferred to each subsystem's capability PRD, not done during core model work.

Evolution path: (1) adapter trait extraction, (2) FCA trait extraction, (3) language_attrs column, (4) storage partition annotation, (5) durable companion pattern for conventions. Each step is a standalone PR.
